name: Hear each part: the line, a muffler and a Helmholtz can (pieces and branches)
msg: Done: 4 steps, each with one more part. Pick any two as A and B, or play every step in order.

name: Hear a misfire: cylinder 1 not firing
msg: Done: play A (all firing) and B (one cylinder not firing). A cylinder that does not fire still pumps its charge out, so its pulse is weak and the note loses its even rhythm: a once-per-cycle beat (half an order, one in every 8 pulses) comes in that a healthy engine does not make. If your own car sounds like B, find the dead cylinder before you change the exhaust.
